features: present; future; imperfective; habitual; historic; atemporal
notes: Also marks the historic present (Na aña 1924 Lago ta establece na Aruba), the near future and timeless facts (p. 43). ta is also a copulative verb (verbs.tsv). The modals kier, mester, por, sa and mag never take ta; gusta is used with or without it (_meta/invariants.md, err-0023).

The future can also be formed with ta bay (Nota, p. 43). p. 42 also lists the compound particle lo a; the maintainer ruled that lo and a never combine (err-0019, _meta/invariants.md), so it has no row here.
